# ffxf_oidc_binding (Resource)

Binds an OIDC identity (for example a GitHub Actions workflow) to a role so it can call the API without a stored secret. A binding's claim conditions must include a `sub` condition that names the owner, and a credential cannot modify its own binding.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ffxf_oidc_providers" "all" {}

resource "ffxf_oidc_binding" "github" {
  provider_id = data.ffxf_oidc_providers.all.providers[0].id
  name        = "github-actions"
  role        = "readers"

  claim_conditions = [
    {
      claim = "sub"
      value = "repo:acme/infrastructure:ref:refs/heads/main"
    },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `claim_conditions` (Attributes List) Claim conditions the token must satisfy; at least one must be a `sub` condition naming the owner. Values may use `*` and `?` wildcards after the owner. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--claim_conditions))
- `name` (String) Binding name, up to 80 characters.
- `provider_id` (Number) OIDC provider identifier, from the ffxf_oidc_providers data source.

### Optional

- `assumable_roles` (List of String) Ids or names of the roles obtainable through token exchange. Required when exchange_only is true.
- `exchange_only` (Boolean) When true the binding can only be exchanged for a short-lived token through POST /auth/token.
- `expires_at` (String) Expiry date in YYYY-MM-DD format; it must be in the future.
- `role` (String) Id or name of the role the binding has the rights of. Required unless exchange_only is true.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the binding is enabled.
- `id` (Number) Binding identifier.
- `role_id` (Number) Identifier of the role the binding holds, null for exchange-only bindings.

<a id="nestedatt--claim_conditions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `claim_conditions`

Required:

- `claim` (String) Claim name, for example sub or repository.
- `value` (String) Expected claim value or pattern.
